ns2:course.label: Exper in the Agency Setting
ns2:course.description: Supervised practical experience in leadership roles in nonschool agency settings; emphasis on observing, planning, and conducting physical activity programs for children and/or adults in preschool, recreation, or other social agencies. May be repeated for a maximum of 6 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated for a maximum of 6 hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Community Health or Kinesiology major(s).
